extra_entries_note: Hand-reviewed entries outside the small-molecule library and the force-field ITPs. source_path is relative to the reference root; the builder adds sha256 and skips an entry whose file is absent.

extra_entries.name: poly(ethylene oxide) / PEG repeat unit EO + hydroxyl terminus OHter (Martini 3)
extra_entries.smiles_verification: polymer building block: one EO bead per ethylene-oxide repeat unit, OHter = hydroxyl end bead (TP1); atom-level mapping not stated in the file; no single-molecule SMILES
extra_entries.doi_note: data file carries no citation; polyply paper (Supplementary Table 1) lists PEO in its Martini3 library. Primary parametrization reference not identified.
extra_entries.source_locator: PEO.martini3.ff: moleculetypes EO (SN3r, 45 amu), OHter (TP1, 36 amu); links: EC-EC bond 0.36/7000, EC-EC-EC angle 2 123/80, CBT dihedral funct 11, OH-EC bond 0.29/7000, OH-EC-EC angle 2 127/110
extra_entries.notes: polyply .ff format (links between residues), not a GROMACS .itp; translate terms manually. Polyply itself is NOT to be run (automatic generator). Dihedral funct 11 = combined bending-torsion (GROMACS manual).

sections.note: pdf_page = 1-based page in the PDF file; printed_page as printed on the page
